summary: Topic 1.4 is quite a whoopy of a doozy. Columbus, the Spanish, smallpox, oh my! Besides looking at the effects of Columbus’s arrival on both the Old and New Worlds, this topic also delves into the Spanish’s conquest of the Aztec and Inca.
